items.title: Deadly shooting near Paris investigated as 'crime of terrorism', minister says
items.description: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks and the suspected gunman has been apprehended.

items.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
items.description: Thirty-four people are also injured in the attack in southern Karak governorate, and a manhunt is now under way.

items.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
items.description: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.

items.title: White House says Melania Trump brokers truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
items.description: Ukraine and Russia confirm the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.

items.title: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted
items.description: The network is used by the Ukrainian military, sources say, and Trump says "if there is a problem, I'll get it straightened out".

items.title: Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike
items.description: Satellite images show oil spreading for miles along the coastline, threatening local marine wildlife

items.title: Denmark to ban mink farming in government U-turn
items.description: Once the world's largest producer of mink pelts, the nation's industry has declined in recent years.

items.title: PSG v Lyon moved as Paris prepares for more protests
items.description: Paris St-Germain's Ligue 1 match against Lyon at the Parc des Princes is pushed back 24 hours as the French capital prepares for another weekend of protests.

items.title: Cyprus police open investigation into financial affairs of Roman Abramovich
items.description: Questions about the integrity of some of Abramovich's professional advisers, were raised earlier this month.

items.title: Woman with Ebola in Nigeria confirmed as wife of Swiss diplomat
items.description: Her husband is currently in isolation but has not developed any symptoms, Swiss officials say.

items.title: Hundreds of flights cancelled as Typhoon Champi shuts Taiwan
items.description: One person has died after being swept away by waves in Taiwan's Liuqiu island, authorities say.

items.title: US justice department investigating Corey Lewandowski over DHS role
items.description: Trump's former campaign manager is reportedly being investigated for allegedly using his role at the Department of Homeland for financial gain.

items.title: Powerful earthquake hits Tibet killing 16 people, reports say
items.description: The quake hit a mountainous, sparsely-populated area in what China calls the Tibet Autonomous Region.

items.title: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC finds
items.description: The UN human rights chief Volker Türk says the multiple attacks may amount to war crimes.

items.title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
items.description: Trump is suing the BBC over an episode of Panorama that edited together two different sections of a speech he gave in 2021.

items.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
items.description: Raghad and Raad's family had to flee their home on foot because of the fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

items.title: Malawi opposition demands answers over president's prolonged stay abroad
items.description: This is President Peter Mutharika's fifth visit to South Africa this year.

items.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
items.description: Websites were taken offline after the developers of programming language PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" had been discovered.

items.title: L'Oreal says weight loss drugs are impacting beauty and skincare sales
items.description: The beauty giant's CEO says the use of GLP-1s is "a very important phenomenon for us".

items.title: Crowd of 50 beats foreigner to death in South Africa
items.description: The attack on the unidentified victim follows a wave of anti-migrants protests in South Africa this year.
